choices.why: No mustard velvet sofa is offered, so the warm cognac leather is the closest to an ochre tone and gives the boho base the user wants better than the black, grey or beige options.
A classic natural rattan tub armchair, exactly the bohemian rattan seat requested, in a warm tone that matches the sofa and the wood floor.
The largest rug, with a rich blue and orange tribal pattern that fills the big room and contrasts happily with the cognac sofa.
A bright teal medallion pattern that pops against the leather and echoes the blue of the rug, enough for both the sofa and the armchair.
A ready-made leafy ZZ plant that brings lots of green to the balcony door, the bookcase and the corners, with a terracotta-toned pot that suits the boho mood.
A wide, low (43 cm) wood and metal shelf that sits neatly under the back-wall window and has room for books and plants.
A generous 110 cm round coffee table in warm wood that is in scale with the sofa and the large rug.
A turned-wood column with a linen shade gives a warm, homely, lived-in look that suits the boho style better than the chrome lamps.
A navy and cream geometric throw with fringe that ties the leather to the blue rug and cushions.

answer.why: No mustard velvet sofa was available, so a cognac leather sofa stands in. Warm natural tones (cognac, rattan, wood, linen) set against a blue and orange rug, teal and navy textiles and plenty of green plants give this bright room the colorful, lived-in bohemian feel the user asked for.
